IPHONE & ANY BROWSER

Priority Desk on iPhone.

There is no App Store app. On iPhone, Priority Desk is a web app: you add it to your Home Screen and it opens full screen like an app.

Open Priority Desk web app ↗

Add it to your Home Screen.

  1. Open prioritydesk.co.uk/app in Safari on your iPhone. Other iPhone browsers can show the app, but Safari is the one that can add it to the Home Screen.
  2. Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up).
  3. Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.
  4. From now on, open Priority Desk from its Home Screen icon. Always use the icon, so your tasks stay in one place on the phone.

Sync with your PC and Android phone.

  1. In the app, tap the ⋮ menu, then Sign in to OneDrive….
  2. Sign in with the same Microsoft account you use with Priority Desk on Windows or Android. Work and school accounts may need an administrator to approve the app first; the menu has a Copy approval link for IT option.
  3. Tap Sync now. Your tasks, projects and attached files appear, and changes you make on the iPhone reach your other devices on their next sync.

Your tasks sync through the Priority Desk folder in your own OneDrive (Apps\PriorityDesk), the same folder the Windows and Android apps use. The developer never receives them.

What is different on iPhone.

  • No reminder alerts on the iPhone. A web app cannot schedule notifications on iPhone. Reminders you set are saved and synced, and they still appear on your Windows PC and Android phone.
  • It syncs while it is open. Open the app and tap Sync now to bring in changes made elsewhere. There is no background sync.
  • You will sign in again about once a day. Microsoft limits how long a web app can stay signed in.
  • It works offline. Your tasks are saved on the phone, and changes sync when you next open the app with a connection.
  • Attachments: you can take a photo, choose a photo or attach a file, up to 100 MB each.

Other browsers and computers.

The web app also runs in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on a computer or Android phone. Open prioritydesk.co.uk/app and sign in the same way. For Windows and Android, the full apps from Microsoft Store and Google Play are better: they show reminders and sync in the background.

Removing it.

Touch and hold the Home Screen icon and choose Remove App. To clear the tasks the web app saved in the browser, also go to Settings, Apps, Safari, Advanced, Website Data and remove prioritydesk.co.uk. Your OneDrive copy stays until you delete the Apps\PriorityDesk folder there. See the privacy policy.
